boundary: Every startup failure remains visible and earns zero completion credit.

rows.failure: whole activation-baton display exceeded the model-visible output bound
rows.recovery: numbered bounded windows read the committed baton completely through EOF

rows.failure: the requested openssl executable was unavailable for a baton digest check
rows.recovery: an in-memory Python SHA-256 projection matched the declared committed-blob digest

rows.failure: combined roster and authorization skill display exceeded its visible result bound
rows.recovery: standalone bounded reads completed both selected skills through EOF

rows.failure: combined tool-bank and orchestration-memory display exceeded its visible result bound
rows.recovery: bounded omitted-line recovery completed both instruction files through EOF

rows.failure: combined authorization-state line windows truncated a middle region
rows.recovery: an exact numbered recovery read the omitted lines before any mutation

rows.failure: first manifest replay launched one external Git process per entry and returned no attributable result
rows.recovery: the abandoned design earned zero credit and was replaced by one exact Git batch projection

rows.failure: first Git batch projection wrote all requests before draining stdout and deadlocked
rows.recovery: a bounded subprocess input projection drained the complete 725-entry response and passed exactly

rows.failure: broad external canonical-receipt searches timed out without an exact match
rows.recovery: the Vesper source task closeout supplied the exact D-backed receipt pointer for scalar rehashing

rows.failure: first source-task read requested an unsupported output-character bound
rows.recovery: the supported bounded reread recovered the exact receipt pointer

rows.failure: combined lane-uniqueness and builder inventory probes returned partial output
rows.recovery: separate scalar branch path and template probes completed the gate

rows.failure: a broad validation-bank text search exceeded its bounded time without a useful match
rows.recovery: the search was stopped and exact phase-local sources were used instead

rows.failure: first lane-creation wrapper had a PowerShell parenthesis parse error before Git ran
rows.recovery: simpler scalar checks proved uniqueness and the one worktree-add operation then completed

rows.failure: sparse-checkout initialization from a no-checkout worktree left an empty index represented as staged deletions
rows.recovery: git read-tree repopulated the fresh lane index directly from immutable HEAD and restored empty cached and working diffs

rows.failure: the first sparse-lane diagnostic printed thousands of inherited deletion rows and exceeded its output budget
rows.recovery: scalar diff-exit status and counts replaced the broad status rendering

rows.failure: first official-source search result projection emitted no visible text because the response shape was misread
rows.recovery: the same bounded official search was projected directly and its source results were retained

rows.failure: first bounded novelty check found two exact inherited title collisions and eleven additional semantic neighbours at or above the quarantine threshold
rows.recovery: only proposal wording was revised and the unchanged exact-collision and 0.75 token-Jaccard gates were rerun before x1 generation
